hints.title: Depth and Height Association
hints.text: Every node belongs to a specific depth level from the root and has a subtree height.

hints.title: Top Heights per Depth Level
hints.text: Removing a subtree at depth d only reduces the overall tree height if that subtree achieved the maximum height among all nodes at depth d.

hints.title: Backup Height Selection
hints.text: For each depth level, store the two largest subtree heights. When the top node is deleted, the second largest takes its place.

hints.title: Precomputed Level Heights Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Linear time traversal precalculates depths and heights, allowing O(1) answering per query.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-traversing the tree to find height for each query results in O(n * q) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) memory to cache heights and top candidates per depth level.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Stores top two subtree heights per depth level to achieve O(1) query response time.
